item.title: Higher maternal BMI linked to increased cardiovascular risk in offspring
item.description: Higher maternal body mass index was associated with an increased risk of cardiovascular disease in offspring, with stronger relationships observed.

item.title: Video mental health care may offer clinical advantages over phone or in-person visits
item.description: In this retrospective cohort study, veterans receiving most outpatient mental health care by video had lower adjusted rates of mental health hospitalization.

item.title: Antibiotics for sinusitis without a real diagnosis [PODCAST]
item.description: Subscribe to The Podcast by KevinMD. Watch on YouTube. Catch up on old episodes! Most people who get antibiotics for a sinus infection never needed them.

item.title: AI virtual cell uses protein dynamics to predict personalized breast cancer treatments
item.description: Not all cancer cells are the same, and neither are their responses to drugs. Finding the right drug for the right cancer cell is a long battle in drug development.
